core_question: Why divide attention scores by sqrt(d_k)?
viewer_problem: Dot products grow with dimension, breaking softmax.
central_insight: Scaling controls variance so softmax stays well-behaved regardless of head dimension.
source_constraints: head_dim is fixed at 128 in the worked example
visual_opportunities: animate logit magnitude growing with dimension
novelty_statement: most practitioners know softmax exists but not why the sqrt(d_k) divisor is specifically variance control
